about: F53: the Misfits are box 0 of the general factory (template 0). F49 E8: N = 4,269. F55: placeholders, the per-item stream and edition specials are add-ons.

Texts are today's launch public names, read byte for byte from packages/contracts/src/v2/names/launch/PublicNames.sol by the generator; the collection description says 4,269 instead of 4,200 (F49 E8; the contracts still say 4,200 until S3).

FIXTURE values (replaced before creation, none of them moves box 0's addresses, BC-064): revealRoot, metadataTable and generatorHash come from the sealed pipeline (K4); openAt is set on launch day (0 = Now). metadataTable (R F75 W1): box 0's genesis loads every Misfit trait, the full table of the commit-ready art (16 types, Character and Finish included; 3,341 bytes at round 7, packages/contracts/test/vectors/box/misfits-trait-table-r7.json), built by scripts/box/misfits-trait-table.mjs; the one-type table here is a stand-in.
gradLayout ASK_FULL_BID_SENTINEL: L7 answered (F61); today's deployed code still seeds layout b' (S4 builds the L7 layout).
Fees (F62, F64, F65): no creator option and no creator buy (version 2 only); royalties 250 bps into box 0's own fee handling (its capped receiver, S5).

Pictures (F74 U3, F75 U10, U11): coverSha256 is the logo (FIT's icon, box 0's token is FIT); collectionCoverSha256 is the collection picture, the Sorter (U11: contractURI image); add-on 6 (collection page, F74 U4) carries banner A (U10: contractURI banner_image), no teasers and no link. Both pictures are the art lane's commit-ready PNGs (branch art-misfits-banner 796eb2f4, docs/design/misfits-v2/banner/final/), committed here by sha256 only: the files stay on the art branch, each pinned to IPFS as one raw block whose CIDv1 is its sha256 (sources).
